analyzer.description: Group to capture, `bits_for(ngroups)` bits; the trigger compares the samples of this group.
analyzer.name: mux_value

analyzer.description: 1: arm the trigger, a term is consumed on each match. The falling edge flushes the terms left in the term memory.
analyzer.name: trigger_enable

analyzer.description: 1: term memory empty, every term matched or flushed (also 1 with no term loaded).
analyzer.name: trigger_done

analyzer.description: Write: push the term (`trigger_mem_mask`, `trigger_mem_value`) into the term memory.
analyzer.name: trigger_mem_write

analyzer.description: Mask of the next term, `data_width` bits: 1 for each bit the term compares.
analyzer.name: trigger_mem_mask

analyzer.description: Value of the next term, `data_width` bits, compared on the bits set in the mask.
analyzer.name: trigger_mem_value

analyzer.description: 1: term memory full (`trigger_depth + 1` terms, `trigger_depth` a power of two of at least 4); a write is lost.
analyzer.name: trigger_mem_full

analyzer.description: Subsampling factor minus one: one sample is kept every `value + 1` cycles, `subsampler_width` bits.
analyzer.name: subsampler_value

analyzer.description: 1: run-length encode the samples from the trigger on. Only with `with_rle=True`.
analyzer.name: rle_enable

analyzer.description: Rising edge: flush the storage and start a capture. Keep at 1 while reading `storage_mem_data`.
analyzer.name: storage_enable

analyzer.description: 1: storage idle, capture complete or never started.
analyzer.name: storage_done

analyzer.description: Words of the capture, pre-trigger window included, `bits_for(depth)` bits; at most `depth`.
analyzer.name: storage_length

analyzer.description: Pre-trigger window in words, `bits_for(depth)` bits; below `depth`.
analyzer.name: storage_offset

analyzer.description: Words still in the storage memory, `bits_for(depth)` bits; read it once `storage_done` is 1. The last words of a capture, up to four, have then moved to the read path and are not counted.
analyzer.name: storage_mem_level

analyzer.description: Read port: next 32-bit sub-word of the capture, least significant first; each read pops it.
analyzer.name: storage_mem_data
